body:
This was my second experiment with LSZ , my first being a week before this one. LSZ is an interesting compound with one isomer of it being more potent then LSD. It has other isomers that are active unlike LSD.
9:00am I drop 1 blotter on my tongue and wait. I observe the blotter tastes like ink slightly but mainly like paper.
9:05am I have held it on my tongue for 5 minutes now, with no numbness present which would indicate the substance on the blotter is not a NBOME.
9:15am I decide to swallow the blotter.
9:30am It hasnt hit me yet but last time I took LSZ it didnt take action till about an hour after taking it.
9:45am I decide to roll a joint feeling something from the LSZ but its very subtle.
9:47am Woah, after having a few puffs my HPPD suddenly increased, odd because it doesnt increase from just cannabis alone anymore.
9:50am I put the joint out so I can save the rest for later feeling like I am coming up now. euphoria is noted and is steadily increasing.  Small changes in visual field has started and sound distortion is occurring.
10:04am I looked at my pupils in the mirror no dilation as of yet.
10:19am Definitely starting to feel the serotonin activity but still no pupil dilation.
10:24am I decide to put on music while coming up the visual phenomena is starting to increase slowly.
10:31am I notice my hands are shaking from anxiety. This exactly like the last time I did LSZ as I got a lot of similar effects to compounds that mainly increase dopamine.
10:45am Mucus and saliva production has increased. I look at my floor, the carpet is moving around in patterns. Headache is noted.
11:00am I start peaking the anxiety is very strong, I might end up taking ativan 1mg to calm myself down.
11:55am after laying down and getting thru the hellish come-up I start feeling OK again. Stomach discomfort is noted and is getting annoying.
12:47pm I looked at my pupils and they were slightly dilated not as dilated as LSD dilates them. It was similar to how much methylphenidate dilates my pupils which isnt a lot but noticeable. Visuals are apparent and are similar to a 100 mic dose of LSD. They were weaker then my last experiment.
Unknown time: I spent the next few hours laying on my bed thinking, relaxing and enjoying the psychedelia.
3:15pm I feel like I am starting to come down.
5:31pm I am sober now.
I would rate this experience as being a ++ on Shulgins rating scale. My last experiment was a +++ at 300 micrograms.
This was a good experience worth repeating but the come-up of LSZ has  been hellishly anxious for me and slow. The stomach discomfort was more apparent this experiment. I have given friends this substance and they reported no anxiety at all during their experiences so  that is an individual reaction. I find LSZ is something to repeat and is enjoyable but I dont think it will carry on much like how LSD did.
[Reported Dose: 150 micrograms]
